breakpoints.note: The compiler materializes the oversized attacker-controlled decimal token into an `IREP_TT_BIGINT` pool entry, preserving the exact digit bytes and bigint base metadata that runtime later uses to instantiate the live `mpz_t` value.

The original guard conflates 'has more than two digits' with 'may inspect the second limb'. When `digits(y) == 1`, the first disjunct is false but the code still evaluates `y->p[1] > 1`. The patch fixes this exact missing obligation by caching `d = digits(y)` and only touching `y->p[1]` when `d == 2`.
